held.why: REFUSED: 'Line 6 finishes it' is false: the sentence begun on line 5 runs on through line 7 ('and the small traffic going in and out of it, as regular as buses.'). And 'so she can count them' has no antecedent: the script never names what goes in and out, so 'them' points at nothing on the screen. Quotations are otherwise verbatim and the line 5 signal fault is fixed.
